Class.summary: Resolves information and claims for the currently authenticated user from the active HTTP request context.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The accessor used to inspect the current HTTP context and user claims principal.

UserId.summary: Gets the unique identifier (GUID) of the authenticated user from the JWT claim. Returns if unauthenticated.

Role.summary: Gets the primary role name (e.g., Admin, SupportAgent, Customer) of the authenticated user. Returns empty string if unauthenticated.
